legal.title: Legal notice and privacy
legal.imprintBody:
Information under § 5 DDG:

[YOUR NAME]
[STREET AND NUMBER]
[POSTCODE AND CITY]
Germany

Contact: kontakt@rwthrank.mindevice.net
legal.controllerBody: The controller under the GDPR is the person named above. Privacy questions go to the same address.
legal.dataBody: rwthrank stores as little as it can. Specifically:
legal.dataEmail: Your email address. It is your account and the way the sign-in link reaches you.
legal.dataProfile: Subject, degree and overall grade. There is no ranking without them.
legal.dataTranscript: Your uploaded transcript is stored, along with the modules, grades, credits and semesters read from it. A transcript contains your name, date of birth and student number. The file is access-protected: it is not reachable at a public address and only you can retrieve it.
legal.dataLogs: Server logs with IP address and timestamp, as any website produces.
legal.basisBody: Your email address is processed under Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR, as it is necessary to provide the account. Your grade, subject, degree and any uploaded transcript are given voluntarily under Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR. You can withdraw that consent at any time by deleting the transcript or your account.
legal.processorsBody: Running the site involves these providers:
legal.processorHetzner: Hetzner Online GmbH, Germany: server and database.
legal.processorCloudflare: Cloudflare, Inc.: DNS and forwarding of email to the operator. Processing also in the USA.
legal.processorGithub: GitHub, Inc. (Microsoft): serving the site via GitHub Pages. Processing also in the USA.
legal.processorResend: Resend, Inc.: sending the sign-in emails, processed in the EU (Ireland).
legal.storageBody: No advertising or analytics cookies are set. Your browser's local storage holds only your session token and your language and appearance settings. Sign-in does not work without them, so no consent is required.
legal.retentionBody: Your account, entries and uploaded transcripts are kept until you delete them. Deleting your account also deletes every transcript and every grade read from them. Sign-in codes expire after five minutes and are deleted as soon as they are used.
legal.rightsBody: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection. An informal email to the address above is enough. You may also complain to a data protection authority; in North Rhine-Westphalia that is the LDI NRW.
legal.trackingBody: rwthrank uses no analytics, no profiling and no ad networks. That is why there is no cookie banner.
legal.updated: Last updated August 2026. This is a general template and is not legal advice.

filter.label: Your subject only
filter.help: Without this you are compared with everyone. Uploading a transcript sets it automatically.
